name: Akagi Mikoto
source: A friendly trap who is popular with both girls and boys and gets often confessed to. The protagonist sees him as a guy friend rather than a girl, but sometimes he gets excited over the things Mikoto does or says; meanwhile Mikoto is in love with him and likes hugging him.
